title: Optimize inference performance
choose_when: A correct baseline misses a specified latency, throughput, memory or cost objective.
required_inputs: fixed workload, quality oracle and baseline
steps: Pin the workload and verify baseline quality.
Locate the limiting stage and estimate headroom.
Measure candidates against the same control and report end-to-end trade-offs.
acceptance_evidence: Paired measurements with the quality gate, uncertainty and workload conditions.
